You @UUID[Compendium.immortal-ardor.classes.hsCJT2h2dgISso8T]{Play a Card} in your hand and channel the power of the card to yourself or an ally within 30 feet. The target gains a beneficial effect for 1 round, depending on the suit Played.@UUID[Compendium.immortal-ardor.classes.n2V2eIe8439vyIZi]{Effect: Standard Play}

  • Strength: Your target adds a status bonus to their damage rolls equal to half your level rounded down. For damage to multiple targets or in an area, select only one target for this extra damage.

  • Dexterity: Your target adds a +1 status bonus to their attack rolls.

  • Constitution: Your target gains a +1 status bonus to AC.

  • Intelligence: Your target gains a +1 status bonus to spell DCs and class DCs.

  • Wisdom: Your target gains a +1 status bonus to Perception checks and saving throws.

  • Charisma: Your target gains a +1 status bonus to all skill checks and DCs.

At 11th level, these bonuses improve. For Strength, the status bonus increases to 2 plus half your level rounded down, and for the other attributes the status bonus increases to 2.
